description: This file defines an interface IAsyncBatchObservable<T> in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which allows for subscribing consumers to observable streams of item batches with optional start tokens. It specifies methods for subscribing with or without a starting sequence token, returning a handle for managing the subscription.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Subscribes a batch observer to the observable, with optional starting sequence token, returning a task that resolves to a subscription handle.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Overload that subscribes a batch observer with a specific sequence token to define the starting point.
